description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Thran Vigil trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
